specs: Full-service bar with beer and wine at $5, mixed drinks from $9
Children 2 and under are free but must be included in booking
Groups of all sizes welcome; no group discounts

blurb: Guests enjoy a 1.5 hour river cruise with dinner including an entrée, soft drinks, and dessert. The cruise features music, sightseeing, and free parking. A full-service bar is available with beer, wine, and mixed drinks sold separately.
extraNote: Reservations of 1–9 tickets require 24 hours notice for full refund or date change · Cancellations made the day of the cruise are not eligible for refund or date change · Reservations of 10 or more tickets require more advance notice for full refund depending on group size · Cruises operate in normal Florida weather including rain; boat is fully enclosed · If severe weather prevents operation, cruise may be cancelled or rescheduled with refund or date change
